en:
Nee-heehee... It's pretty strange that you
would come talk to me, Kaede.

Whatever, I just felt like it. If you don't want
to spend time with me, just say so.
What!? Why would I do thaaaat!?

I'd *never* turn down an invitation from you,
Kaede.
...Kidding! That was a lie!
Geez...

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm already exhausted. Maybe I shouldn't have
reached out to Kokichi.

Hey, don't take that tone with me.
After all...
...it's your fault I'm mean to you.
My fault?
Because...you've forgotten about me.
Huh? Forgotten!?
Are you lying again?
W-Wait a minute!
Are you thinking of someone else?
Are you unsure of something?

I can't bear it anymore! I haven't forgotten!
I've been thinking about you this whole time!
Are you lying again?
Huh...?

I wish I was...but even I'm not that good at
lying.

Ah-haha... I may be an evil supreme leader,
but even my lies have standards.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi seems pretty serious about this...
H-Have we actually met each other before?

O-Okay, then if you're not lying, can you help
me jog my memory so I can remember?

W-Wait a minute! I don't remember ever
meeting you...

So you did forget! You completely wiped
me out of your memories!

How could you be so heartless...?
I'm so...devastated...
<CLT=cltMIND>Is Kokichi genuinely sad...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Have I really forgotten about him!?

I-I'm so sorry! Can you help me jog my
memory so I can remember you?
Are you thinking of someone else?

There's no way I'd mistake the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate
Pianist<CLT=cltNORMAL> for anyone else.

Only Gonta would make such a major mistake...
No, not even Gonta's that dense!
I guess that's true...

Then, can you help me jog my memory so
I can remember?

Like, where we met or what was going
on when we met... Stuff like that.
Hmmm, let's see. We met...

...under hostile circumstances similar
to this.
Huh?

You sheltered me while I was on the run
from my enemies.

With your piano skills, you managed to raise
enough money to fund my escape...

But then I betrayed you! I sold you out to
my enemies and you were swiftly killed!

<CLT=cltMIND>Th-There is no freaking way any of that
is true...
That was all a lie!
Yup, it sure was! We met each other here!

I can't believe you fell for that, Kaede.
You're such a sucker.
Geez...

<CLT=cltMIND>Yeah... This is the sort of prank a kid who
wants attention would pull.

You keep this up and you just might be the
first one who gets killed, y'know?

Hey, Kokichi... Some things are just best left
unsaid. You know what I mean?

Oh, you mad? Sorry, sorry! Then I won't
say anything at all!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Kokichi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltMIND>After parting ways with Kokichi, I returned to
my room feeling very annoyed.
